Migration.Purpose: Deployment and runtime topology derived from the Android Automotive requirements and existing build/release configuration.

Target.Platform: Android Automotive OS on Changan UNI-S/CS55 Plus head units.
Target.Architecture: arm64 Android application running Flutter UI plus a foreground-service background isolate.
Target.VehicleInterface: android.car HVAC, cabin-temperature, and ignition properties through the local AndroidAutomotivePlugin.

RuntimeTopology.UiIsolate: Bootstraps GetIt, accessibility, theme, blocs, and the foreground service before rendering the app shell.
RuntimeTopology.BackgroundIsolate: Runs the service-specific bootstrap, listens for ignition and HVAC events, and controls heating independently from the UI isolate.
RuntimeTopology.NativePlugin: Provides awaited connect/read/write calls and event callbacks; native failures propagate to Dart.

Lifecycle.Startup: App launch, boot, or accessibility wake initializes the service and registers HVAC listeners.
Lifecycle.IgnitionOff: Await stopService and turn both seats off; bounded restart-backoff handles transient runtime failures.
Lifecycle.Background: Foreground notification keeps automatic behavior available while the app is not visible.

BuildAndRelease.Workflow: .github/workflows/release.yml builds an arm64 APK on push of a v* tag.
BuildAndRelease.ReleaseNotes: CHANGELOG.md section matching the release version becomes the GitHub Release body.
BuildAndRelease.ManualSmoke: Validate real HVAC connection, seat levels, automatic mode, foreground lifecycle, ignition OFF, and raw-to-Celsius behavior on the target head unit.

OperationalRisks.Risk-1: Native permissions and head-unit availability can make connect fail outside the vehicle.
OperationalRisks.Risk-2: Cold-boot notification timing may need a delayed initialization workaround.
OperationalRisks.Risk-3: Different vehicle models may expose different temperature encodings.
